metadata.note: Synthetic example, not real data. Fictional Sample River Basin near Null Island.

properties.title: Head-end scheme irrigation in Ardena
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. Farmers with land in the head-end blocks receive canal water under the scheme's seasonal allocation plan and report reliable supply in both main seasons.
properties.source: SAMPLE-FGD-01 p.2; SAMPLE-INT-03 l.40; SAMPLE-ADM-01 row 12 (synthetic source codes)

properties.title: Tail-end scheme irrigation in Corvel
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. Tail-end farmers hold the same land-based entitlement as head-end farmers but say water rarely reaches their blocks after the wet season.
properties.source: SAMPLE-FGD-02 p.4; SAMPLE-INT-07 l.15 (synthetic source codes)

properties.title: Basin agency operation of Sample Weir
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. The basin agency operates the weir and the main intake gate and sets the opening schedule each season.
properties.source: SAMPLE-ADM-02 p.1; SAMPLE-INT-01 l.8; SAMPLE-OBS-01 (synthetic source codes)

properties.title: Town water utility intake on the Sample River
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. A town utility abstracts raw water below the weir for its piped network outside the basin.
properties.source: SAMPLE-ADM-03 p.2; SAMPLE-INT-02 l.31 (synthetic source codes)

properties.title: Water user association rotation on canal S2
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. A registered water user association divides the S2 share among its members by a weekly rotation agreed at a seasonal meeting.
properties.source: SAMPLE-FGD-03 p.1; SAMPLE-INT-05 l.22 (synthetic source codes)

properties.title: Household dug wells in Belmora
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. Most households draw drinking and washing water from shallow dug wells without any permit or registration.

properties.title: Garden watering from Ridge Brook in Dunhal
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. Households carry or hose small quantities from the brook to vegetable gardens.

properties.title: Ridge Spring under customary stewardship
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. A customary steward opens the spring for household use each morning and closes it during an annual cleaning ceremony.
properties.source: SAMPLE-FGD-04 p.2; SAMPLE-INT-09 l.12; SAMPLE-OBS-03 (synthetic source codes)

properties.title: Customary rotation on the Ridge Spring channel
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. Upland farmers take turns on the spring channel in an order set by the steward.
properties.source: SAMPLE-FGD-04 p.3; SAMPLE-INT-10 l.4 (synthetic source codes)

properties.title: Diesel pumping from the main canal tail
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. Tail-end farmers rent diesel pumps to lift water from the canal tail into their fields; users report no permit, and the agency says it does not act on the pumps.
properties.source: SAMPLE-INT-07 l.33; SAMPLE-INT-01 l.52 (synthetic source codes)

properties.title: Night-time canal-bank breach for irrigation
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. One respondent reports that some farmers open a breach in the canal bank at night during the second dry season.

properties.title: Village piped supply with an expired permit
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. The village government runs a piped supply from the river; the abstraction permit shown to the team had expired, and all parties treat the use as lawful.

properties.title: Unregistered pump group in Dunhal
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. A farmer pump group shares a pump on the brook but is not registered, so it cannot hold a permit in its own name.
properties.source: SAMPLE-FGD-05 p.2; SAMPLE-INT-08 l.19 (synthetic source codes)

properties.title: Reservoir fishing below Sample Weir
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. Residents fish in the pool below the weir; no water or fisheries rule addresses the practice.

properties.title: Reed harvesting in the Corvel wetland
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. Households cut reeds in the wetland below the drain outlet for roofing and sale.

properties.title: Planned minimum flow below Sample Weir
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. A draft basin plan proposes a minimum release below the weir in the dry seasons; it is not yet in force.

properties.title: Brick works abstraction permit in Belmora
properties.description: Synthetic example, not real data. A brick works holds a long-term abstraction permit for a borehole.
